detail: Both corpus texts ingested from .txt with `lc ingest` (plain paragraphs: the converter writes no headings) and indexed with `lc anchor`: doc-control segment over the converted .docx with the novel profile and its per-format settings (chapter_blank_lines 2 for .txt, chapter_level auto for .md) and the work language; every chapter start carries doc-control's `isolated` signal. Detected chapter starts compared with the gold heading lines in tests/fixtures/gold/chapters.json. scene_boundary_f1 over the nine variants of tests/test_anchor.py stays 1.0.

differences_from_old_detector.chapter_starts: none: the same 10 and 22 chapter starts as structure.detect gave
differences_from_old_detector.chapter_titles: Jekyll and Hyde: none. Marianela: 18 of 22 titles equal the old detector's ('-I- Perdido'), from doc-control's heading_last; the other 4 gain a title line the old detector left out as too long: -III-, -X-, -XIV- ('-XIV- De cómo la Virgen María se apareció a la Nela') and -XVIII-
differences_from_old_detector.anchors: Jekyll and Hyde: 0 of 350 change. Marianela: 204 of 1,270 change, all inside those 4 chapters (the title line moves from scene 1 to the heading block in scene 0)
differences_from_old_detector.scenes: same count (11 and 23); scene_style (an 'after break' paragraph style) opens a scene again and is recorded in structure.json signals
differences_from_old_detector.dropped_signals: none: every T6 request is now in doc-control (T49, T50, T51)
differences_from_old_detector.breaks: an ornament right under a chapter title stays in the heading block (scene 0) again, from doc-control's whole in-process list of suppressed scene starts (no_text_between)

timing: lc ingest + lc anchor, worst of three in-process runs: jekyll-hyde 0.13 s before, 0.27 s after; marianela 0.33 s before, 0.63 s after (anchor 0.07 s -> 0.24-0.35 s: the .docx is converted and parsed again for segment)
